title: Not All Invariants Are Equal: Curating Training Data to Accelerate Program Verification with SLMs
authors_zh: Ido Pinto、Yizhak Yisrael Elboher、Haoze Wu、Nina Narodytska、Guy Katz
paper_type_zh: 形式化 verifier 驱动的循环不变量数据构造、开放发布与 SFT 实证
best_for_zh: 构建程序验证训练数据、研究 programmatic feedback，或审计 verifier 标签与运行时归因的研究者
one_line: WONDA turns raw verifier invariants into compact loop-invariant SFT targets, but reuse requires distinguishing the 7,763-row curated table from the grade-filtered 7,284-sample experiment set and auditing lineage, licenses, and version drift.
WONDA 将 UAutomizer 原始循环不变量整理为紧凑 SFT 目标，并分别记录归纳正确性、充分性与 verifier 加速，但复用时必须区分 7,763 行 curated 表和 7,284 条实验训练集，并补查 lineage、许可与版本漂移。
why: It makes a formal verifier part of the data-construction contract while revealing that a verifier-valid invariant, a useful invariant, and a faster invariant are distinct labels.
inclusion_reason: WONDA exposes an end-to-end open recipe for turning symbolic verifier output into SFT targets whose induction, sufficiency, and verifier-time utility are recorded separately.

title: Problem
问题
html:
WONDA asks why one-shot invariant generators trained on formally correct solver output still fail to help a verifier on difficult C programs. Its ICML 2026 paper and arXiv v2 trace the problem to the training target: UAutomizer can emit inductive proof invariants that are thousands of characters long, enumerate cases, contain casts and redundant Boolean structure, and encode one solver-specific proof rather than the simpler program relation a model should learn. Directly using these targets can therefore preserve correctness while reducing pedagogical value.

The paper's object is not a free-form chain of thought. A source row contains a C verification query, a target loop location, UAutomizer's baseline decision and runtime, and one or more raw invariants. A curated row adds the normalized form, an optional Kimi K2 Thinking simplification and rationale, the selected target invariant, separate correctness and sufficiency decisions, verifier timings, a speedup label/factor, and a four-level quality grade. The SFT serializer turns that record into a marked C program and a single JSON target, {"marker": ..., "content": ...}.

This belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because the central contribution is a reproducible transformation and selection contract: normalize, generate semantic alternatives, formally grade them, and serialize selected targets for SFT. It is adjacent to programmatically verifiable outcome data, but the canonical category remains the construction track. It does not contribute process-supervision labels or an RLVR experiment, and it does not show that the model's unobserved reasoning process is correct.

The L4 boundary is unusually concrete: paper v2 and its appendices specify the quality function, prompts, dataset counts, SFT settings, evaluation metrics, hardware, and UAutomizer release; the official repository and Hugging Face collection publish code, raw/curated/evaluation tables, and models. What remains unresolved is item-level source licensing, grouped split construction, semantic decontamination, a tagged paper-matching code release, and independent reproduction.

WONDA 研究的是：为什么用“形式上正确”的 solver 输出训练一次性 invariant generator，模型在困难 C 程序上仍不能稳定帮助 verifier。ICML 2026 论文及 arXiv v2 把问题定位到训练目标本身：UAutomizer 输出的归纳不变量可能长达数千字符，枚举大量 case，夹带类型转换与冗余布尔结构，并编码某一种 solver 特有证明，而不是模型更应学习的简洁程序关系。因此，直接使用这些目标可以保留正确性，却降低教学价值。

论文的数据对象不是自由形式 chain of thought。来源记录包含 C 验证查询、目标循环位置、UAutomizer baseline 判定与运行时间，以及一个或多个原始不变量；curated 记录再加入规范化形式、可选的 Kimi K2 Thinking 简化结果及 rationale、最终 target invariant、彼此独立的正确性与充分性判定、verifier 时间、加速标签/倍数和四级质量分。SFT 序列化器把它变成带 marker 的 C 程序和单个 JSON 目标：{"marker": ..., "content": ...}。

该工作属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes，因为核心贡献是可重建的变换与选择契约：规范化、生成语义替代、形式化分级，再把合格目标序列化用于 SFT。它也邻近 programmatically verifiable outcome data，但 canonical category 保持为构造 track。论文没有提供 process-supervision 标签，也没有开展 RLVR 实验，更没有证明模型的隐藏推理过程正确。

其 L4 证据边界较清楚：论文 v2 与附录给出质量函数、prompt、数据量、SFT 设置、评测指标、硬件和 UAutomizer 版本；官方仓库与 Hugging Face collection 发布代码、raw/curated/evaluation 表及模型。仍未解决的是 item-level 来源许可、按程序分组的 split、语义去污染、与论文完全匹配的 tagged code release，以及独立复现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WONDA makes “high-quality invariant” an executable data contract rather than a readability judgment. A candidate must be non-degenerate; induction is checked as V(A, P, I); sufficiency is checked as V(A ∪ {I}, P, q); and practical utility compares the parallel verification time max(t1, t2) with direct baseline time tb. This produces grades 0–3: non-inductive; inductive but insufficient; inductive and sufficient without speedup; and inductive, sufficient, and faster. The reported V2 SFT set accepts grades 2 and 3.

The construction has two transformations. Deterministic AST normalization removes tautologies and contradictions, minimizes parentheses, and strips casts. The logical rewrite rules are semantics-preserving, but cast stripping is explicitly not guaranteed to be; the downstream verifier is therefore essential. For normalized invariants of at least 20 characters, Kimi K2 Thinking sees the program, invariant, and loop marker and samples four compact alternatives. Candidates may be weaker, stronger, equivalent, or incomparable to the raw invariant; only the two formal checks decide whether they become training targets.

The feedback system can observe validity of the encoded C verification queries and verifier runtime under one pinned environment. It cannot certify semantic equivalence to the source invariant, readability, uniqueness, portability to another verifier or architecture, absence of source leakage, or ownership of the program. A grade-3 label is consequently environment-relative evidence, not a universal quality label.

The closest baseline is InvBench's one-shot training on raw UAutomizer invariants. WONDA retains that source/evaluation setting but changes the target distribution and exposes induction, sufficiency, and speedup as separate fields. Iterative systems such as Loopy, LaM4Inv, and LEMUR instead use repeated generate-and-verify or repair at inference; WONDA improves a single proposal and is complementary to those loops rather than replacing them.

WONDA 把“高质量 invariant”写成可执行的数据契约，而不是可读性的主观判断。候选首先不能退化；归纳正确性通过 V(A, P, I) 检查；充分性通过 V(A ∪ {I}, P, q) 检查；实际效用则比较并行验证时间 max(t1, t2) 与直接 baseline 时间 tb。由此得到 0–3 级：非归纳；归纳但不充分；归纳且充分但不加速；归纳、充分且更快。论文报告的 V2 SFT 集只接收 grade 2 和 3。

构造过程有两类变换。确定性的 AST normalization 删除重言式和矛盾式、最小化括号并去除类型转换。逻辑重写规则保持语义，但论文明确说明去 cast 不一定保持语义，因此后置 verifier 不可缺少。对于长度至少 20 字符的规范化不变量，Kimi K2 Thinking 读取程序、不变量和循环 marker，并采样四个紧凑替代。候选可以比原始不变量更弱、更强、等价或不可比；只有两项形式化检查决定其能否成为训练目标。

该反馈系统可以观察指定 C 验证查询在一个固定环境中的有效性和 verifier 运行时间；它不能证明候选与来源不变量语义等价、可读、唯一，不能保证迁移到另一 verifier 或架构后仍成立，也不能证明没有来源泄漏或程序权利完整。因此，grade 3 是环境相对证据，不是普适质量标签。

最接近的 baseline 是 InvBench 使用原始 UAutomizer 不变量进行一次性训练。WONDA 保留其来源/评测设置，但改变目标分布，并把归纳正确性、充分性和加速拆成独立字段。Loopy、LaM4Inv、LEMUR 等迭代系统在 inference 时反复 generate-and-verify 或修复；WONDA 改善单次 proposal，与这些循环互补，而不是取代它们。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Collect. Load InvBench training programs, run UAutomizer, and keep rows with a TRUE baseline and at least one extracted loop invariant. The raw public table contains source filename, original/rewritten program views, baseline decision, timing, easy/hard label, and invariant list.
  2. Normalize. Parse each raw invariant to an AST; apply bottom-up tautology/contradiction rules, parentheses minimization, and cast removal. Reject TRUE, FALSE, 0, and 1 targets.
  3. Generate. If the normalized invariant is at least 20 characters, query Kimi K2 Thinking through Together with the full simplification prompt. The checked official config uses temperature 1.0, max_tokens=16384, and n=4. Exact-whitespace-normalized duplicates are removed. Compact invariants bypass the LLM.
  4. Verify and grade. Parse each candidate as a side-effect-free C Boolean expression. In parallel, UAutomizer checks induction/correctness and target sufficiency. The maximum of the two runtimes is compared with the row's median direct-verification time. A normalized fallback is checked if all LLM variants fail.
  5. Release and select. Deep-copy the source row and add gt_invariant: marker, raw/pretty/simplified/target forms, rationale, Boolean correctness/sufficiency/speedup fields, numeric speedup, grade, and per-check timings. The curated-full Hub table has 7,763 rows and is not directly SFT-ready. The paper's V2 experiment filters grade >= 2 and chat-template length <= 1,024, yielding 7,284 examples split 5,827/1,457.
  6. Train and evaluate. Serialize one marked program and one JSON invariant target for SFT. The paper reports full fine-tuning for Qwen3-0.6B/4B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Mistral-7B, with Qwen3-8B using LoRA. On InvBench, each model emits one invariant per designated loop; the same formal checks yield validity, correctness, speedup, VBP, and latency-inclusive VBP-E2E over three trials.

The paper-matching verification substrate is UAutomizer 0.3.0-dev-d790fec (SV-COMP 2025), Java 21, 32-bit unreach-call, 16 GB via runlim, and a 600-second timeout on an AMD EPYC 9354/L40S node. Reproduction should also pin the code commit, upstream programs, model revisions, tokenizer/chat template, Together-served Kimi revision, random seeds, baseline timing runs, and candidate/order concurrency. The checked master commit 678ab76b3db3ffb5cd21a726b9036cf4d8d5329b has no release tag, and current Qwen3-8B/14B default configs do not completely mirror the paper's LoRA assignment, so paper settings must take precedence until that drift is resolved.

可重建流程如下：

  1. 收集。 载入 InvBench 训练程序，运行 UAutomizer，只保留 baseline 为 TRUE 且至少提取到一个循环不变量的记录。公开 raw 表包含来源文件名、原始/改写程序视图、baseline 判定、时间、easy/hard 标签和 invariant 列表。
  2. 规范化。 把每个原始不变量解析为 AST，自底向上应用重言式/矛盾式规则、括号最小化和去 cast；排除 TRUE、FALSE、0、1 等退化目标。
  3. 生成。 若规范化不变量至少 20 字符，则通过 Together 调用 Kimi K2 Thinking，并提供完整 simplification prompt。所核验官方配置使用 temperature 1.0、max_tokens=16384、n=4；按空白规范化后的精确字符串去重。紧凑不变量不经过 LLM。
  4. 验证与分级。 把每个候选解析为无副作用 C 布尔表达式；UAutomizer 并行检查归纳正确性与目标充分性，以两次运行的最大值和该记录的直接验证 median time 比较。所有 LLM 变体失败时，再检查规范化 fallback。
  5. 发布与选择。 深拷贝来源记录并加入 gt_invariant：marker、raw/pretty/simplified/target 形式、rationale、正确性/充分性/加速布尔字段、数值 speedup、grade 和两项验证时间。Hub 上 curated-full 表有 7,763 行，并非直接 SFT-ready；论文 V2 实验再筛 grade >= 2 且 chat-template 序列长度 <= 1,024，得到 7,284 条，并按 5,827/1,457 划分。
  6. 训练与评测。 把一个带 marker 的程序和一个 JSON invariant 目标序列化用于 SFT。论文对 Qwen3-0.6B/4B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 报告 full fine-tuning，Qwen3-8B 使用 LoRA。InvBench 上每个模型为指定循环输出一个不变量，再由同一形式化检查计算 validity、correctness、speedup、VBP 和含 latency 的 VBP-E2E，共运行三次。

与论文匹配的验证环境是 UAutomizer 0.3.0-dev-d790fec（SV-COMP 2025）、Java 21、32-bit unreach-call、runlim 限制 16 GB、单项 600 秒 timeout，硬件为 AMD EPYC 9354/L40S 节点。复现还应固定 code commit、上游程序、模型 revision、tokenizer/chat template、Together 提供的 Kimi revision、随机种子、baseline timing runs，以及候选/并发次序。核验的 master commit 678ab76b3db3ffb5cd21a726b9036cf4d8d5329b 没有 release tag，当前 Qwen3-8B/14B 默认配置与论文 LoRA 分配也不完全一致；在漂移被解释前，应以论文设置为准。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main evidence is a controlled V0→V1→V2 target ablation on the 123-instance Hard split, averaged over three runs. For Qwen3-4B, base/V0/V1/V2 correctness is 22.8/29.3/33.1/44.4%, while speedup rate is 11.1/13.6/12.7/24.7%; validity falls from 99.2% for the base model to 81.3% under raw V0, recovers to 97.6% under normalization, and reaches 100% under V2. For Llama-3.1-8B, V2 raises correctness from 14.9% to 45.5% and speedup rate from 5.4% to 18.4%. Mistral-7B shows the same raw-target failure: validity changes from 93.8% base to 68.8% V0, then 95.9% V1 and 99.5% V2. These results support the claim that target construction matters; they do not isolate the LLM rewrite from every change in sample count or target distribution.

Table 3 gives end-to-end conditions. Qwen3-4B-V2 lowers VBP-E2E from 185.7 to 165.7 seconds and raises correctness from 22.8% to 44.4%. Qwen3-14B-V2 reports VBP-E2E 162.9 seconds, close to GPT-5.2's 163.4 seconds, but its correctness is 43.4% versus 72.4% for GPT-5.2. That comparison supports a portfolio-time claim, not model parity. Qwen3-0.6B is a useful negative result: V2 correctness is slightly lower than base (27.9% versus 28.5%) even as speedup rate improves (14.1% versus 12.2%) and VBP-E2E drops from 183.0 to 174.1 seconds. Correctness and operational utility are therefore demonstrably different labels.

The data-yield evidence is also auditable. Starting from 4,000 raw invariants, 2,995 verbose items generate 11,980 candidates; 6,584 (55.0%) reach grade >= 2. Another 1,005 compact items are checked directly, 983 of which reach grade >= 2. The pipeline emits 7,763 curated rows; grade and length filtering leaves 7,284 V2 SFT samples, of which 4,516 are grade 2 and 2,768 grade 3. Mean target length is 15.8 tokens. The grade-3 subset averages 2.13× verifier speedup, with a reported maximum of 41.39×.

The authors also report limits to the observed gain. Only a few of 20 baseline-timeout Hard instances are solved per run; Qwen3-14B-V2 averages about 3.3. On the Easy split, V2 improves correctness, but direct verification already averages about 6.15 seconds and speed metrics are omitted. All numbers are author-reported under one UAutomizer/hardware setup; this Card did not independently reproduce training or verification.

主要证据是在 123 个 Hard instance 上进行的 V0→V1→V2 目标消融，结果为三次运行平均值。Qwen3-4B 的 base/V0/V1/V2 correctness 分别为 22.8/29.3/33.1/44.4%，speedup rate 为 11.1/13.6/12.7/24.7%；validity 从 base 的 99.2% 降到原始 V0 的 81.3%，经 normalization 恢复至 97.6%，V2 达到 100%。Llama-3.1-8B 的 V2 把 correctness 从 14.9% 提到 45.5%，speedup rate 从 5.4% 提到 18.4%。Mistral-7B 也表现出原始目标失效：validity 从 base 的 93.8% 变为 V0 的 68.8%，再恢复到 V1 的 95.9% 和 V2 的 99.5%。这些结果支持“目标构造很重要”，但没有把 LLM 改写与样本数或目标分布的全部变化完全隔离。

Table 3 给出 end-to-end 条件。Qwen3-4B-V2 把 VBP-E2E 从 185.7 秒降到 165.7 秒，并把 correctness 从 22.8% 提到 44.4%。Qwen3-14B-V2 的 VBP-E2E 为 162.9 秒，接近 GPT-5.2 的 163.4 秒，但 correctness 为 43.4%，而 GPT-5.2 为 72.4%。该比较只支持 portfolio time 结论，不能证明模型能力相等。Qwen3-0.6B 是有价值的负结果：V2 correctness 略低于 base（27.9% 对 28.5%），但 speedup rate 提高（14.1% 对 12.2%），VBP-E2E 从 183.0 秒降至 174.1 秒。由此可直接看出，正确性与运行效用是不同标签。

数据 yield 也可审计。4,000 个原始不变量中，2,995 个 verbose item 生成 11,980 个候选，其中 6,584 个（55.0%）达到 grade >= 2；另有 1,005 个 compact item 被直接检查，其中 983 个达到 grade >= 2。管线输出 7,763 行 curated 记录；经 grade 与长度筛选后，V2 SFT 集剩 7,284 条，其中 grade 2 为 4,516 条、grade 3 为 2,768 条。目标不变量平均长度 15.8 token。grade-3 子集平均 verifier speedup 为 2.13×，报告最大值 41.39×。

作者也报告观察收益的边界。Hard split 中 20 个 baseline timeout instance 每次只有少数被解决；Qwen3-14B-V2 平均约 3.3 个。Easy split 上 V2 提高 correctness，但直接验证平均仅约 6.15 秒，因此未报告 speed 指标。所有数字均为作者在单一 UAutomizer/硬件环境下的报告；本 Card 没有独立复现训练或验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
InvBench already framed one-shot invariant generation as program plus loop marker to invariant, used UAutomizer-generated training targets, and evaluated whether a proposed invariant helps formal verification. Earlier generate-and-verify systems also used symbolic tools to filter or repair LLM proposals. AST cleanup, LLM rewriting, SFT, and verifier portfolios are therefore not individually new.

WONDA's concrete change is to make the training target itself a verifier-measured object. It separates four properties that raw solver output had conflated: non-degeneracy, induction, sufficiency for the target assertion, and lower solver time. Its semantic simplifier is allowed to leave the equivalence class of the source invariant; soundness is recovered by rechecking the actual rewritten candidate rather than trusting the LLM. This converts a proof artifact into multiple formally labeled alternatives and preserves why a row was retained.

The grade contract also exposes a distinction important for reasoning-data research: correct is not the same as sufficient, and neither guarantees faster. The Qwen3-0.6B result demonstrates that speed-oriented curation can improve portfolio time without improving correctness rate. That is more informative than treating every verifier-passing record as one homogeneous positive class.

Compared with Loopy, LaM4Inv, and LEMUR, the method spends extra verifier/teacher budget during dataset construction and retains a one-shot inference interface. Compared with raw InvBench training, it changes target syntax, semantic diversity, and acceptance. Its directional value is the open candidate-level contract and release, not a first use of formal verification or a proof that semantic simplification always dominates raw data. Before reuse, a study should equalize candidate/verification budgets, compare with non-LLM simplifiers and iterative inference, audit program-level splits and licenses, and pin the paper-matching implementation.

InvBench 已把一次性 invariant generation 定义为“程序与循环 marker → invariant”，使用 UAutomizer 生成的训练目标，并评测候选是否帮助形式化验证。更早的 generate-and-verify 系统也已用符号工具过滤或修复 LLM proposal。因此，AST 清理、LLM 改写、SFT 和 verifier portfolio 这些组件本身并非首次出现。

WONDA 的具体变化，是把训练目标本身变成 verifier 可测的数据对象。它拆开原始 solver 输出中被混合的四项属性：非退化、归纳正确、对目标 assertion 充分、以及减少 solver 时间。语义简化器可以离开来源不变量的等价类；soundness 不是靠信任 LLM，而是重新检查实际改写候选来恢复。这样，一个 proof artifact 被转换为多个带形式化标签的替代目标，并保留记录被接收的原因。

grade 契约还揭示了 reasoning-data 研究中的关键区别：correct 不等于 sufficient，二者也都不保证 faster。Qwen3-0.6B 结果直接说明，面向 speed 的 curation 可以改善 portfolio time，而不提升 correctness rate。这比把所有 verifier-passing 记录视为同一正类更有信息量。

相较 Loopy、LaM4Inv、LEMUR，该方法把额外 verifier/teacher 预算放在数据构造期，并保留一次性 inference 接口；相较原始 InvBench 训练，它改变目标语法、语义多样性和接受条件。方向价值来自开放的 candidate-level 契约与发布，而不是首次使用形式化验证，也不是证明语义简化总优于 raw data。复用前应对齐候选/验证预算，与非 LLM 简化器和迭代 inference 对比，审计 program-level split 与许可，并固定与论文匹配的实现。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Method and verifier. UAutomizer is the sole invariant source and acceptance oracle. Sound conclusive decisions do not imply completeness: timeouts and UNKNOWN can drop useful candidates, and changing solver heuristics may change both grades and runtimes. Grade 2/3 establishes induction and sufficiency for the encoded 32-bit unreach-call query, not semantic equivalence to the raw invariant, readability, minimality, or usefulness under another verifier. Cast removal is acknowledged as potentially non-semantics-preserving; re-verification protects accepted candidates but not the interpretation of rejected transformations.

Data and release. The raw table, curated-full table, evaluation data, models, and code are public, but release boundaries matter. Curated-full has 7,763 rows and can include grade-1 candidates; the paper's 7,284-sample V2 experiment additionally requires grade >= 2 and a 1,024-token limit. SFT-ready caches are model-family-specific local builds, while legacy Hub caches remain available. Treating these artifacts as one interchangeable dataset can silently change the target population. Rejected grade-0 candidates and complete API-generation traces are not a first-class release.

Split, provenance, and rights. The paper reports an 80/20 sample split but not whether all variants from one program stay in one partition. Exact-match candidate deduplication does not address semantic duplicates or related program families. Training and evaluation descend from InvBench/SV-COMP-related sources, yet no item-level overlap/decontamination manifest is published. The repository is MIT; that does not establish redistribution/training rights for upstream programs, Hub tables, model outputs, or benchmark derivatives. No verified per-source dataset-license manifest was found.

Measurement and attribution. Grade 3 and the Easy/Hard boundary depend on hardware, UAutomizer version, concurrency, timeout, and baseline timing. VBP is a virtual per-instance oracle portfolio; VBP-E2E adds measured model latency only for qualifying instances and is not the same as a deployed scheduling policy. Model comparisons do not hold correctness constant—Qwen3-14B-V2 matches GPT-5.2's VBP-E2E while having much lower correctness. Three-run means do not characterize all sampling or solver variance.

Reproduction and drift. The checked official master commit has no release tag. Current training defaults do not fully reproduce the paper's stated LoRA assignment for Qwen3-8B and full tuning for Qwen3-14B, making commit/config pinning necessary. The served Kimi K2 Thinking revision, API nondeterminism, random seeds, and exact training/evaluation artifact hashes are not disclosed. These are curator-identified reproducibility risks; they are not evidence that the reported results are wrong.

方法与 verifier。 UAutomizer 是唯一不变量来源和接受 oracle。判定为 sound 并不代表 complete：timeout 与 UNKNOWN 可能丢弃有用候选，solver heuristic 改变也可能同时改变 grade 和运行时间。grade 2/3 只能证明候选对所编码 32-bit unreach-call 查询归纳且充分，不能证明与原始不变量语义等价、可读、最小，也不能保证对其他 verifier 有用。论文承认去 cast 可能不保持语义；重新验证保护被接收候选，但不能解释被拒变换是否本来有价值。

数据与发布。 raw 表、curated-full 表、evaluation data、模型和代码均公开，但必须区分发布边界。curated-full 有 7,763 行，可能包含 grade-1 候选；论文 7,284 条 V2 实验集还要求 grade >= 2 和 1,024-token 限制。SFT-ready cache 按模型族在本地构建，旧 Hub cache 仍可用。把这些 artifact 当成同一个可互换数据集会静默改变目标分布。被拒 grade-0 候选和完整 API generation trace 没有作为一等发布物提供。

Split、provenance 与权利。 论文报告 80/20 sample split，但没有说明同一程序的全部变体是否留在同一 partition。exact-match 候选去重无法处理语义重复或相关程序族。训练与评测均来自 InvBench/SV-COMP 相关来源，却没有公开 item-level overlap/decontamination manifest。仓库采用 MIT，但这不能证明上游程序、Hub 表、模型输出或 benchmark 衍生物的再分发/训练权利；未找到经核验的逐来源 dataset-license manifest。

测量与归因。 grade 3 和 Easy/Hard 边界依赖硬件、UAutomizer 版本、并发、timeout 和 baseline timing。VBP 是按 instance 选择最优项的虚拟 oracle portfolio；VBP-E2E 只对合格 instance 加入模型 latency，不等同于真实部署调度策略。模型比较也没有固定 correctness——Qwen3-14B-V2 的 VBP-E2E 接近 GPT-5.2，但 correctness 明显更低。三次运行均值不能覆盖全部采样与 solver 方差。

复现与漂移。 核验的官方 master commit 没有 release tag；当前训练默认值不能完整复现论文所述 Qwen3-8B LoRA 与 Qwen3-14B full tuning 分配，因此必须固定 commit/config。Together 提供的 Kimi K2 Thinking revision、API 非确定性、随机种子，以及训练/评测 artifact 的精确 hash 均未披露。这些是 curator 识别的复现风险，并不表示论文结果错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, WONDA is a concrete blueprint for upgrading machine proof artifacts into auditable teaching targets. A builder can copy the separation between source artifact, semantics-changing proposal, formal acceptance, and model-ready serialization. The key reusable pattern is to store induction, sufficiency, and runtime utility separately rather than collapse them into one “verified” flag.

A defensible reproduction should ingest the raw Hub table, retain source IDs and every candidate, run deterministic normalization, pin Kimi and UAutomizer versions, write both verification reports and timings, group splits by source program, and publish the exact grade/length filter used for each SFT cache. It should also release grade-0/1 failures, timeout/UNKNOWN reasons, semantic-duplicate analysis, and a per-source license manifest. The public code provides modules for preprocessing, syntax validation, UAutomizer execution, SFT serialization, training, and multi-run evaluation, so this is a practical starting point rather than a paper-only recipe.

The quality grade can support several studies beyond the reported SFT experiment: grade-2 versus grade-3 target ablations; cost-aware candidate allocation; cross-verifier transfer; prediction of verifier speed from invariant syntax; and curriculum designs that separate induction from sufficiency. Grade-1 and rejected candidates may be useful as contrastive or diagnostic data, but the paper does not validate them for preference learning, reward modeling, or RLVR, so those uses require new experiments and a carefully defined negative-label contract.

Reuse class: the verified official release is usable for controlled training and audit experiments after pinning code/data/model versions and resolving the applicable upstream licenses. It is not yet a drop-in contamination-clean corpus. The evaluation split is reusable only with its UAutomizer/hardware caveat, and reported benchmark scores should be used as recipe evidence rather than proof that every released row is high quality.

对指定的 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track，WONDA 是把机器 proof artifact 升级为可审计教学目标的具体蓝图。构建者可以复用“来源 artifact、会改变语义的 proposal、形式化接受、model-ready 序列化”四层分离。最关键的可迁移模式，是分别存储归纳正确性、充分性和运行时效用，而不是压缩成一个“verified”标志。

可信复现应读取 raw Hub 表，保留来源 ID 与所有候选，执行确定性 normalization，固定 Kimi 和 UAutomizer 版本，写入两类验证报告及时间，按来源程序分组划分，并发布每个 SFT cache 的精确 grade/长度过滤条件。还应发布 grade-0/1 failure、timeout/UNKNOWN 原因、语义重复分析和逐来源 license manifest。公开代码已包含 preprocessing、语法校验、UAutomizer 调用、SFT 序列化、训练和多次评测模块，因此它是可执行起点，而非只有论文描述的配方。

质量 grade 还能支持论文 SFT 之外的研究：grade-2 与 grade-3 目标消融、cost-aware 候选分配、跨 verifier 迁移、根据不变量语法预测 verifier speed，以及把 induction 与 sufficiency 分离的 curriculum。grade-1 和被拒候选可能适合做 contrastive 或诊断数据，但论文没有验证其用于 preference learning、reward modeling 或 RLVR；这些用途需要新实验与明确的负标签契约。

复用等级：在固定代码/数据/模型版本并确认上游适用许可后，已核验官方发布可用于受控训练与 audit 实验；它尚不是可直接投入的 contamination-clean corpus。evaluation split 只能在保留 UAutomizer/硬件边界的前提下复用，报告 benchmark 分数应被视为配方证据，而不能证明每一条发布记录都是高质量数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.2 and 4.2 plus Algorithms 1–2 first: induction, sufficiency, and speedup are separate labels, and the LLM rewrite need not be equivalent to the raw invariant.
  • Keep three populations distinct: 4,000 raw invariants processed, 7,763 rows in the curated-full release, and 7,284 grade/length-filtered V2 samples used by the reported SFT experiment.
  • Table 4 is the strongest data-quality evidence: raw V0 targets can damage syntax validity, V1 repairs much of it, and V2 yields the largest cross-family gains.
  • “Matches GPT-5.2” refers to VBP-E2E under a virtual portfolio; Qwen3-14B-V2 has substantially lower invariant correctness.
  • Grade 3 is environment-relative because verifier version, hardware, timeout, concurrency, and baseline timings define the speedup label.
  • Before reuse, inspect the program-grouped split, InvBench/SV-COMP lineage, dataset licenses, rejected candidates, and the drift between paper and current training configs.

• 先读 Sections 3.2、4.2 与 Algorithms 1–2：归纳正确性、充分性和 speedup 是独立标签，LLM 改写也不要求与 raw invariant 等价。
  • 严格区分三个人群：处理的 4,000 个原始不变量、curated-full 发布中的 7,763 行，以及论文 SFT 实验实际使用的 7,284 条 grade/长度过滤 V2 样本。
  • Table 4 是最有力的数据质量证据：raw V0 目标可能损害 syntax validity，V1 修复大部分问题，V2 才在多个模型族上取得最大收益。
  • “匹配 GPT-5.2”指虚拟 portfolio 下的 VBP-E2E；Qwen3-14B-V2 的 invariant correctness 明显更低。
  • grade 3 是环境相对标签，因为 verifier 版本、硬件、timeout、并发和 baseline timing 共同定义 speedup。
  • 复用前应检查按程序分组的 split、InvBench/SV-COMP lineage、dataset license、被拒候选，以及论文与当前训练配置之间的漂移。
